# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_known_bots

Configures known bots for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/known_bots`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_known_bots` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_known_bots" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status           = true
    bad_bots         = true
    bad_bots_action  = "block_period"
    good_bots_action = "bypass"

    bad_bots_list {
      item {
        cat    = "DoS"
        status = true
        allow_list {
          item {
            value = "AB"
          }
        }
      }
    }

    good_bots_list {
      item {
        cat    = "Known Search Engines"
        status = true
        deny_list {
          item {
            value = "Ask"
          }
        }
      }
    }

    exception_list {
      item {
        concatenate_type = "AND"
        match_target     = "COOKIE"
        operator         = "REGEXP_MATCH"
        value_name       = "session_id"
        value_check      = true
        value            = "terraform-matrix"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed known bots configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_known_bots` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_known_bots.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
